main_and_ablation_are_distinct_designs: The 48-treatment design was frozen before its MILP calls. The subsequent 14-treatment crossover is a post-observation mechanism study selected after that result, with its own frozen protocol and new seeds.
posthoc_gap_consistency_gate: Added to analysis after observing a completed report with a 528.4306% displayed gap; not represented as a prespecified experimental treatment or extra solver resolution.
shared_preparation: Canonical models and factors were reused. Copying/export/preexisting-witness checks are timed in each design; original model acquisition/construction and prior witness acquisition are not charged to individual cycles.
persistence: Main-study final delivered NPZ persistence is measured separately. Ablation includes final delivered NPZ saving within total_seconds without a separate persistence timer. Auxiliary phase/LP certificates are within their stages in both designs.
timing_limits: Sum of requested MIP TimeLimits is at most 15 seconds. Native overhead may make observed optimization times slightly larger. The full-cycle reference is 20 seconds, not an OS real-time guarantee.
scope: No new independent application families, population inference or globally certified MILP optimum. Contracts specify experimental algebraic primal budgets and do not validate dual bounds. Base/IF1 remains competitive. OMS v1.3.5 is unchanged.
